interpretations: For each media type ID with matched tracks, show its name, the sum of its tracks’ non-null `Bytes` divided by the sum of all its tracks’ `Milliseconds`, and that rate divided by the arithmetic mean of the rates for all represented media type IDs; keep separate rows for IDs that share a name.

For each distinct media type name among matched tracks, combine tracks from IDs with that name, calculate the ratio of the two totals, and divide it by the arithmetic mean of the rates for all distinct names.

For each media type ID with matched tracks, exclude tracks whose `Bytes` is null from both totals when calculating its rate, then divide that rate by the arithmetic mean of the resulting media type rates.
For each media type ID with matched tracks, treat null `Bytes` as zero when calculating its rate, then divide that rate by the arithmetic mean of the media type rates.
For each distinct media type name, combine tracks from IDs with that name to calculate its rate, then divide by the simple mean of the rates calculated separately for each represented media type ID.
For each represented media type ID, calculate its rate separately, then divide by the simple mean of the rates calculated from combined tracks for each distinct media type name.
queries:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT
    m.MediaTypeId,
    m.Name,
    1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(t.Bytes, 0)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM MediaType AS m
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
)
SELECT
  Name,
  rate,
  rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM rates)
FROM rates

WITH rates AS (
    SELECT m.Name,
           1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.Name
)
SELECT Name,
       rate / AVG(rate) OVER () AS normalized_rate
FROM rates

WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
  MediaTypeId,
  rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates) AS normalized_rate
FROM media_type_rates;

WITH media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    1.0 * SUM(COALESCE(Bytes, 0)) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
  MediaTypeId,
  rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM media_type_rates) AS relative_rate
FROM media_type_rates

WITH id_rates AS (
    SELECT
        mt.MediaTypeId,
        mt.Name,
        SUM(t.Bytes) AS total_bytes,
        SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS total_milliseconds,
        1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate
    FROM MediaType AS mt
    JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
    WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
)
SELECT
    Name,
    (1.0 * SUM(total_bytes) / SUM(total_milliseconds)) / AVG(rate) AS rate_ratio
FROM id_rates
GROUP BY Name;

WITH id_rates AS (
    SELECT MediaTypeId,
           SUM(Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS rate
    FROM Track
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
name_rates AS (
    SELECT m.Name,
           SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END) AS rate
    FROM Track AS t
    JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
    GROUP BY m.Name
)
SELECT MediaTypeId,
       rate / (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM name_rates) AS relative_rate
FROM id_rates;
